latest.title: Fourier Analysis and Idempotents in Quandle Algebras
latest.abstract: In 2023, the first author, Nunez, Singh, and Swain [10] formulated an analogue of Kaplansky's idempotent conjecture for integral quandle rings. In this paper, we develop a new Fourier-analytic approach to quandle rings and use it to establish the conjecture for two major classes of quandles: Takasaki quandles, including dihedral quandles, and medial commutative quandles. A central contribution of the paper is the introduction of Fourier analysis on Alexander quandles, which provides a new framework for studying quandle rings and, in particular, their idempotents. Using this Fourier-analytic framework, we also prove that a previously known sufficient condition for the existence of counterexamples to the conjecture is in fact necessary, thereby resolving a problem of Jablonowski [12].
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 建立 Alexander quandle 上的傅里叶分析，证明积分 quandle 环的 Kaplansky 型幂等元猜想对 Takasaki（含二面体）及交换 medial quandles 成立，并解决一个必要性问题。
latest.breakthrough: 引入可推广的频域框架，并把已知反例充分条件提升为必要条件，显著收紧幂等元结构。
latest.limitations: 猜想只在两大 quandle 类中解决，一般非 medial 或更复杂 quandle 仍开放。
latest.priorityReason: 为结不变量相关代数提供新工具和完整子类结果，但与几何分析主线较远。
